user.title: Connect to pveupdate
user.description: Needs pveupdate 0.8.0 or later on your Proxmox host, so that the connection is encrypted. Run `pveupdate serve` on the host and paste the whole output of `pveupdate token`.

reauth_confirm.title: New pveupdate token
reauth_confirm.description: The token was rejected, the host's certificate no longer matches it, or it comes from before pveupdate 0.8.0, which is now required so that the connection is encrypted. Update pveupdate on the host if needed, run `systemctl restart pveupdate-serve`, then paste the whole output of `pveupdate token`.

reconfigure.title: New pveupdate token
reconfigure.description: Paste the whole output of `pveupdate token` from the host. Needs pveupdate 0.8.0 or later.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach pveupdate on that host and port. Is `pveupdate serve` running? After updating pveupdate, restart it with `systemctl restart pveupdate-serve`.
error.token_without_certificate: This token has no certificate fingerprint, so the connection can't be encrypted. Update pveupdate on the host to 0.8.0 or later, run `systemctl restart pveupdate-serve`, then paste the whole output of `pveupdate token`.

abort.already_configured: This host is already set up.

init.title: Proxmox Guest Updates options
init.description: Choose the LXCs and VMs pveupdate manages. Untracked guests are removed from Home Assistant.

error.cannot_list_guests: Could not get the guest list from pveupdate. Update pveupdate on the host to 0.6.0 or later, and check `pveupdate serve` is running.
error.guests_locked: Tracked guests can only be changed on the host, because `remote-track` is off there. You can still change the check interval.
error.busy: A check or update is running. Try again when it finishes.
